description: This file defines a factory class for generating User model instances with fake data in a Laravel application. It includes methods for setting default user attributes and marking emails as unverified.

classes.name: UserFactory
classes.description: A factory class for generating User model instances with default data.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Returns an array with default attributes for a User, including name, email, password, and token.

methods.name: unverified
methods.description: Sets the email verification timestamp to null to mark the email as unverified.
